claim: The University of Luxembourg says applications for 2027-2028 open on 1 February 2027, and its programme pages give windows running from 1 February to July.
excerpt: Applications for the academic year 2027-2028 will open on 1 February 2027.
interpretation: This describes applying. The state portal describes a period running from the end of April to mid-September and calls it enrolment, which is recorded separately as ev-guichet-unilu-enrolment-window. The likeliest reading is that the two pages describe different stages of the same process — but that is an inference about two pages that do not cross-reference each other, and the state portal's own banner says it is being updated. The product states neither window.

notes: uni.lu returns an empty body to automated retrieval. This page was read in a browser on 2026-09-23, and the host began returning 403 to the browser as well partway through the session.

attestation.by: the deadline research pass, Alpine and small states group
attestation.note: Read in a browser because automated retrieval returns nothing, alongside the state portal page it disagrees with.

claim: The Luxembourgish state portal, on its page about enrolling at the University of Luxembourg, says the period runs from the end of April to mid-September for a bachelor.
excerpt: from the end of April to mid-September
interpretation: Taken at face value this contradicts the university's own 1 February opening, recorded as ev-unilu-application-window-2027. Two things make it impossible to resolve from the pages alone: the portal does not say whether it means applying or enrolling after admission, and it carries a banner reading "This page is currently being updated" — the publisher warning that its own content may be stale. Note the direction of the temptation: this is the *government* page, which would normally outrank an institution's, and it is also the later and more forgiving window. Preferring it for either reason would be preferring the convenient reading of a page that says it is out of date.

notes: The resolution is not ours to make. The University's student department (SEVE) is the office that can settle it, and the country record tells the student to work from their own programme page and confirm with SEVE.

attestation.by: the deadline research pass, Alpine and small states group
attestation.note: Read on 2026-09-23 alongside the university page it disagrees with.

interpretation: Neither Sacred Heart University Luxembourg nor BBI appears. Both were removed from the country profile on this pass: shu.lu is a parked domain ("This domain may be for sale") and the campus is reported closed since July 2022; www.bbi-edu.eu now serves an Italian crypto-casino page. claim: Admission depends on nationality, residence and where the qualification was earned, and every applicant must prove proficiency in all teaching languages of the chosen programme.
excerpt: The admission of each applicant depends on their personal situation. In addition, the prerequisites may vary depending on the applicant’s nationality, their place of residence, and where they earned their qualification. […] All applicants must demonstrate proficiency in all teaching languages of their chosen programme at the University of Luxembourg, unless stated otherwise on the programme web page.
interpretation: The IB is not named on this page; eligibility is decided per applicant by an interactive checker. The language rule is the practical filter: a bilingual programme needs proof in both languages.
